🎥🎬: Six Feet Under (2001)

The Fisher family runs a funeral home in Los Angeles, where death is an everyday reality and grief is part of their business. When family patriarch Nathaniel Fisher dies unexpectedly, his sons Nate and David are forced to return home and take over the family business alongside their mother, Ruth, and younger sister, Claire.

As they prepare the dead for their final journeys, each member of the family struggles with personal demons, complicated relationships, hidden desires, and the fear of living an unfulfilled life. Nate searches for meaning beyond his responsibilities, David wrestles with his identity, and Claire navigates the confusion of growing up.

Through dark humour and deeply emotional moments, the Fishers confront mortality, love, family conflict, and the choices that shape their lives. Their work constantly reminds them that death is inevitable, but learning how to live is far more complicated.
